subject: skill/stack/flask
claim: Structure repo Flask apps as an application factory with blueprints, and return dicts/lists from views so Flask auto-serializes JSON. Always escape untrusted input: Jinja autoescapes .html/.htm/.xml templates, and manual output uses markupsafe.escape while uploaded filenames pass through werkzeug.utils.secure_filename. Set a real random secret_key (secrets.token_hex()) for cookie-backed sessions, and never expose the development server or debugger in production because they execute arbitrary code.
notes: Quickstart backs dict/list auto-JSON, HTML escaping, secure_filename, secret_key generation and the debugger-warning. Patterns backs the factory/blueprint/request-scoped-SQLite structure (Application Factories, Working with Blueprints, Using SQLite 3 with Flask). Both agree; uncertainty is modest because the Patterns source fetched as an index of sub-pages rather than full prose.
